pose.description: Primary whole-body pose; variations belong in notes.

view.description: Dominant torso orientation relative to camera.

notes.description: Brief pose, crop, limb, contact, occlusion, perspective, motion, or floor/chair context. Do not describe styling or the original clothing. Empty string when none.

styling.description: A concise compatible styling prior from Image 1: visible layering, tuck or overlap, sleeve treatment, waist relationship, accessory placement, or relaxed/structured wearing logic. Never target garment identity, category, color, print, logo, exact construction, hidden details, background, lighting, or photographic style. Empty string when none.

garments.description: Target outfit items shown in Images 2 onward, including garments, footwear, bags, belts, hats, and accessories.

main_refs.description: Images defining overall silhouette, proportions, structure, or major construction.

shape.description: Intrinsic design silhouette and structural form: proportion, volume, shoulder, bodice, waist, skirt/leg, hem, shoe silhouette, or major construction. Exclude pose folds, temporary deformation, Image 1 styling, and details better represented in key_details.

fabric_behavior.description: Visible material behavior when worn or moved: crispness, softness, stretch, structure, fluidity, volume retention, drape, cling, and fold behavior.

presentation.description: How this target item is worn within the fixed subject pose, crop, view, and occlusion, including compatible layering, overlap, tuck, sleeve, waist, accessory, contact, and natural folds. Do not repeat shape or identity, or change pose/crop to reveal hidden details.

key_details.description: Materially useful, clearly visible, source-grounded details beyond shape, ordered most important to least important. Omit generic, tiny, ambiguous, or invisible details.

region.description: Semantic location such as overall, collar, cuff, waistband, pocket, hem, footwear, bag_front, or buckle. Use overall only for all-over patterns, stripes, color blocking, broad panel arrangement, or distinctive whole-item layout.

description.description: Factual source-grounded detail to reconstruct, beyond the item's shape.

source_ref.description: Exactly one clearest authoritative image for this detail; split facts into separate details when they require different sources.
